up: Find all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1133765'. Join docs (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765') to compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Return molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as ChEMBL_ID, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as Name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase as Max_Phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type as Molecule_Type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles as Canonical_SMILES. Order the results by ChEMBL_ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS ChEMBL_ID, md.pref_name AS Name, md.max_phase AS Max_Phase, md.molecule_type AS Molecule_Type, cs.canonical_smiles AS Canonical_SMILES FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133765' ORDER BY ChEMBL_ID
